a: Typically up to $1.5M a year for 5 years per award (topic limits apply, often no more than 6 funded faculty); about $170M in total for the FY27 MURI competition
dt: Optional white paper due Nov 20, 2026, 5 pm ET; full proposal due Apr 9, 2027, 5 pm ET (per the NOFO).
e: AFOSR's posting of the FY2027 Department of War MURI competition; its AFOSR topics are nonlinear EUV/X-ray mixing, tunable goniopolar semiconductors, AI for scientific discovery, TEM ptychography and optical cycling centers. Only US universities (and eligible UARCs) may apply; the NOFO sets no citizenship limit for PIs.
